title: Power Rankings: Mavs, Spurs battle for Western supremacy
heading: 2005-06 Power Rankings: Week 13

rankings.summaryHtml: Trying to keep it fresh with those ''boring'' Pistons, we steal this line from Bernie Bickerstaff: ''Most teams have a go-to player. They have a go-to team.''

rankings.summaryHtml: How do you make a run at the Southwest crown and the West's No. 1 seed when you're last in the league in assists? With the league's deepest roster, that's how.

rankings.summaryHtml: Duncan and Ginobili aren't playing at full strength, true. But nothing has changed: Every team in the league outside of Detroit would trade for Spurs' problems.

rankings.summaryHtml: Losing Vince is obviously the killer blow, but this hurts, too: Nets no longer have the league's longest win streak of the season now that Pistons have won 11 straight.
